gap: No result ChatGPT got says that BLUETTI's SolarX 4K, the add-on the Apex 300 needs to go past its built-in 2,400 W of solar, only takes panels from 150 V to 500 V and steps them down to below 60 V for the unit, so a small 2×200 W panel kit can't simply be moved onto it, and that it comes in two different cable versions (P090D 'for Single Use' and XT60 'for Parallel Use').
standout_why: ChatGPT's results were Anker F3800 and F3800 Plus store pages, the Jackery Explorer 5000 Plus manual and store pages, and the F3800 Plus technical brief. None of them cover BLUETTI, the SolarX 4K's 150–500 V panel window, the two cable versions, or the fact that the B300K is sold as separate versions for each power station. The Anker pages do cover their own 11–165 V solar window and outlet list. Anker's warning that the 240V output can't be used while charging from 120V AC sits on the F3800 Plus page, and the F3800 page (result 1) probably carries the same FAQ, so that one only rates 1. I could not open the technical brief PDF (PDF text extraction was blocked here), so I haven't checked what it says.
kit_items: power station: BLUETTI Apex 300. BLUETTI's page says 'the dual inverter allows simultaneous operation of 120V and 240V devices on one unit' and gives 3,840 W output. Unlike the Anker F3800 Plus, which shows 'Sold Out' on Anker's US store today, it can be bought now.

expansion battery: BLUETTI B300K, the 'B300K for Apex 300/200' version, which comes with the CA90 battery cable. Don't buy the 'B300K for AC500' or 'B300K for AC200L/AC300' versions; BLUETTI says the AC500 hookup needs a separate P090D-to-P150D cable.
solar panels: the 2×200 W panels in BLUETTI's own 'Apex 300+B300K+2*200W' bundle. These go into the Apex 300's built-in solar inputs. Their wattage is too low to reach the SolarX 4K's 150 V minimum.

solar cable: BLUETTI Solar Charging Cable (20 A MC4 to XT60), sold as the Apex 300 solar cable. The Apex 300 'in the box' list shows only an AC charging cable, a car charging cable and a grounding screw, with no solar cable.
optional, for a bigger array only: BLUETTI SolarX 4K, the P090D 'for Single Use' version for one Apex 300. It needs a panel string of 150–500 V and is a separate $699 item.
